name: A Lay Of The Land

steps.t: Reach the Jiangsu Warehouse
steps.go: Head for the warehouse in the north-west of the map. The whole quest must be done in one round.

steps.t: Find the shipping notes in the foreman's office
steps.go: Go up to the second floor and into the foreman's office. The notes sit on the desk by the windows.

steps.t: Locate the scanners on the upper floor of Control Tower A6
steps.go: Climb Control Tower A6 to the wrecked office area. The scanners are on the floor behind the office dividers.

steps.t: Deliver 1 LiDAR Scanner to Shani
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Extract with the scanner, ideally in a safe pocket, and hand it to Shani.

notes: Step 3 wording varies: the wiki says 'on the upper floor of Control Tower A6', op.gg says 'in the Flight Control office of Control Tower A6'. Same place.

name: Power Out

steps.t: Find the Electrical Substation south of the Spaceport
steps.go: Travel to the substation in the south, near the Security Checkpoint. Do it all in one round.

steps.t: Find any sign of the missing engineer
steps.go: Search around the substation for clues the engineer left behind.

steps.t: Install the fuse
steps.go: Fit the fuse at the substation's fuse point.

steps.t: Restore the power
steps.go: Go to the generator by the substation and switch the power back on.

notes: All sources agree on the four objectives. No guide gives the exact spots for the engineer clue or fuse; pin 'Power Generator' is assumed to be the restore step.

name: The Clean Dream

steps.t: On Spaceport, search 4 containers in the underground tunnels
steps.go: Drop into the tunnels by the Launch Towers. Most containers are on the raised walkway or in its small control rooms.

steps.t: Find and monitor any Filtration System in the tunnels
steps.pin: Find and Monitor any Filtering System in the Tunnels
steps.go: Find the green water tank just right of the valve near the tunnel entrance and interact with it, then extract.

steps.t: On The Blue Gate, visit the Maintenance Bunker
steps.go: Blue Gate map. Head to the bunker in the centre, south-east of Checkpoint, near the Overlook Airshaft exit.

steps.t: Monitor the Purification System in the bunker
steps.go: Blue Gate map. Go down to the central room's lower floor and interact with the big cylinders.

steps.t: Find and photograph the blueprints in the bunker
steps.go: Blue Gate map. Back up on the walkway, turn left then right into the desk room and use the folder stack.
steps.show: Photograph the folders on the desk.

notes: op.gg and PC Gamer agree on the steps above. arcraiders.wiki differs: 'find the underground tunnels', search 2 (not 4) containers, no filtration step, then 'Find the Purification System Blueprint' and 'Deliver it to Apollo' instead of photographing. Probably an older version. A second pin 'Filtration System' sits next to the chosen pin for the same step.

name: The Stench Of Corruption

steps.t: Reach the southwest lobby of the Departure Building
steps.go: Go to the Departure Building west of the Launch Towers and enter by its jutting southern side, near the car park.

steps.t: Find the staff locker room
steps.go: Walk north along the lobby walkway. The door marked Staff Room is on your left.
steps.show: Staff Room door on the left.

steps.t: Search the room for any clues of the saboteur's identity
steps.go: Check the two hazard suits on the rack to your right to get the Flushing Terminal Key.

steps.t: Reach the tunnels below the Spaceport
steps.pin: Reach the tunnels below the Spaceport
steps.go: In front of the Launch Towers, drop through the hole in the concrete.

steps.t: Use the key on any Flushing Terminal to override the bypass protocol
steps.go: Find a Flushing Terminal in a control room off the walkway and use the key. Do it all in one round.

notes: Must be done in one round; the key is lost on death.

name: On The Map

steps.t: Head to where the Fuel Lines snapped, and transmit your location
steps.go: Go to the middle of the broken long pipes and transmit from there.

steps.t: Head to the antenna near the Fuel Control, and transmit your location
steps.go: Find the satellite tower outside Fuel Control's west door, next to Rocket Assembly, and transmit at its south base.

steps.t: Head to the cactus patch in the wall breach, and transmit your location
steps.go: Go to the big wall breach between Rocket Assembly and Container Storage and stand in the middle of the cacti.

steps.t: Transmit your location from the roof of the Container Storage building
steps.go: Enter Container Storage on the east ground floor and ride the zipline up. Transmit as you step off.

steps.t: Find the container covered in tarp, and mark it
steps.go: Drop to the lowest level, find the tarp-covered container in the sand and spray it from the nearby beam.

notes: There is no '#1' pin; 'Quest Start Point' is assumed to be the Fuel Lines spot. Guides put the Fuel Lines directly below the Departure Building, so check that pin.

name: Worth Your Salt

steps.t: Go to the Rocket Assembly
steps.go: Head to the Rocket Assembly hangar with the red walkways, next to Fuel Control. Finish it all in one round.

steps.t: Search for the hidden Battery Prototype in a high place
steps.go: Climb the stairs to the walkway and follow it to the corner. The battery is in a box by the red lockers.

steps.t: Bring the Battery Prototype to the Industrial Recharger
steps.go: Carry the battery to the big recharger in the middle of the hangar, near the exit.

steps.t: Use the machinery to charge the battery
steps.go: Pull the handle on the side of the recharger.

steps.t: Deliver the Charged Battery to the drop-off point in the corner
steps.go: Drop it in the small open box in the hangar corner by the exit. No need to extract.

notes: PC Gamer reports a bug: the drop-off can fail if another player in the match has already delivered.

name: Dust On The Wires

steps.t: Visit any Field Depot on the eastern side of the Spaceport
steps.go: Go to either Field Depot on the east side of the map.

steps.t: Use the Field Radio to transmit the scout group's last log to Shani
steps.go: Use the Field Radio at the depot to send the log.

steps.t: Interact with the terminal in the old Raider Tower north of the Maintenance Hangar
steps.pin: Terminal in the old Raider Tower
steps.go: Climb the old Raider Tower north of the Maintenance Hangar and use its terminal.

steps.t: Find traces of the scout patrol near the Maintenance Hangar
steps.go: Search around the Maintenance Hangar for signs of the scouts.

steps.t: Search the remains left by the scouts
steps.go: Loot the scouts' remains close by to get the Scout Patrol Note.

steps.t: Deliver the Scout Patrol Note to Shani
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Extract with the note and give it to Shani.

notes: The wiki notes its dialogue places the watchtower south of the Spaceport, while the objective says north of the Maintenance Hangar. Objectives match across sources.

steps.t: Activate the security sensors in one of the Guard Towers
steps.go: Go to any guard tower on the perimeter and switch on its sensors. Bring batteries.

steps.t: Start the Security Control Center in the Departure Building
steps.go: Head into the Departure Building and power up the security control centre.

steps.t: Search for any traces of a security breach in the Arrival Building Data Office
steps.go: Go to the Data Office in the Arrival Building and search for the source of the breach.

steps.t: Search the buses near the western gate
steps.go: Go to the buses by the western gate and search them.

steps.t: Locate the stash of sabotage supplies hidden at the Water Towers
steps.go: Head north to the Water Towers and find the hidden stash.

name: When Everything Falls

steps.t: Go to the Water Towers
steps.go: Bring a camera and head to the Water Towers in the north-west.

steps.t: Photograph a Security Booth
steps.go: Follow the road from the Water Towers to the small booth and snap it.

steps.t: Photograph a reinforced bus
steps.go: Keep along the same road to the armoured buses and photograph one.

steps.t: Photograph the breach in the walls
steps.pin: Photograph the breach in the walls
steps.go: Turn east to the broken wall near the Departure Building and the Spaceport sign.

steps.t: Photograph the Arrival Building security room
steps.pin: Photograph the Arrival Building security room
steps.go: Go round to the Arrival Building's north-west side, breach the sealed door and photograph the room.

steps.t: Photograph Port A of the Launch Towers
steps.pin: Photograph Port A of the Launch Towers
steps.go: From outside, get a clear view of the Launch Towers, standing on something high if needed.

steps.t: Photograph the Launch Towers control room
steps.pin: Photograph the Launch Towers control room
steps.go: Enter by a side door and ride the zipline up to the control room. Expect campers.

steps.t: Photograph the launch platform
steps.go: Take the stairs from the control room to the top platform for the last shot.

notes: arcraiders.wiki page could not be read. Duplicate-purpose pins also exist: 'Security Booth', 'Armoured Bus', 'Launch Tunnel A Photograph', 'Take a photo of the Launch Tower Control Room', 'Take a photo of the Launch Tower Pad'. No turn-in extraction needed.

name: Empathetic Prototypes

steps.t: Reach the Trench Towers in the Spaceport Trench
steps.go: Go to the North Trench Tower and climb to the roof by ladder or grapple. Bring healing.

steps.t: Find the Magnetic Lock on the Crate and manually disable it
steps.go: Head down the stairs, grapple across the windows and drop onto the hanging crate. Use the arm to lower it.
steps.show: Drop on crate, release the lock.

steps.t: Search the Cargo Crate
steps.go: Once the crate is on the ground, search it for the Project Pathos Empathy Core.
steps.show: Loot the core from the crate.

steps.t: Deliver the Project Pathos Empathy Core to Lance
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Extract with the core and give it to Lance.

notes: The wiki lists step 2 as a choice: 'Find the Terminal and disable the Magnetic Lock' or disable the lock on the crate manually. Destructoid covers only the manual route. Unlocked after Someone Else's Shoes.

steps.t: Use the Magnetic Decryptor in the Fuel Control Building
steps.go: Enter Fuel Control by the south-west door, through 'Authorised Personnel Only', and use the terminal at the far end.

steps.t: Reach the Arrival Building in Spaceport
steps.pin: Reach the Arrival Building in Spaceport
steps.go: Head over to the Arrival Building.

steps.t: Use the Magnetic Decryptor on the top floor of the Arrival Building
steps.go: Climb to the top-floor offices and use the second-to-last terminal on the right of the stack.

name: Prescriptions Of The Past

steps.t: Visit the Departure Building in Spaceport
steps.pin: Visit the Departure Building in Spaceport
steps.go: Head to the Departure Building, west of the Launch Towers.

steps.t: Find the Medical Exam Room inside the Departure Building
steps.go: Search inside the building for the medical exam room.

steps.t: Search for the records
steps.go: Search the exam room for the medical records.

notes: No source gives the exam room's exact spot inside the building.

name: Switching The Supply

steps.t: Find the tunnels under the Spaceport
steps.pin: Find the tunnels under the Spaceport
steps.go: Get into the tunnels under the Launch Towers, avoiding ARC on the way. Do it in one round.

steps.t: Find and turn the valve in the tunnels under Spaceport
steps.go: Find the valve near the tunnel entrance, beside the green filtration tank, and turn it.

notes: Valve location near the tunnel entrance comes from PC Gamer's Clean Dream guide.
